name: davy-safety-lamp
description: A flame shielded by fine wire gauze let miners carry light underground without igniting explosive gas.

name: swiss-army-knife-introduced
description: A Swiss cutler began supplying soldiers with a folding multi-tool knife, the archetypal pocket gadget.

name: electric-flashlight-ever-ready
description: A battery and bulb in a tube gave people a portable light to carry in a coat or bag after dark.

name: kodak-brownie-camera
description: A cheap cardboard box camera sold for a dollar and made photography a pastime for children and families.

name: thermos-vacuum-flask
description: A German glassblower's double-walled vacuum bottle kept drinks hot or cold on journeys and picnics.

name: leica-i-camera
description: A compact German camera using cine film showed that serious pictures could come from a device that fit in a coat.

name: zippo-lighter-introduced
description: A Pennsylvania company launched a windproof metal lighter with a hinged lid that clicked open with a thumb.

name: handie-talkie-radio
description: A hand-held two-way radio let infantry talk to each other without wires, an early step toward carry-anywhere communication.

name: kodak-instamatic-camera
description: A camera with a snap-in film cartridge needed no threading, putting easy photography in millions of pockets.

name: hp-35-pocket-calculator
description: A shirt-pocket calculator handled logs and trigonometry, making engineers' slide rules obsolete within a few years.

name: motorola-dynatac-8000x
description: The first commercial hand-held mobile phone cost thousands of dollars, weighed about a kilo and took ten hours to charge.

name: blackberry-email-device
description: A Canadian company's two-way device with a tiny keyboard let business people read and answer email on the move.

name: apple-ipad-introduced
description: A slab-like touchscreen tablet bridged phone and laptop, becoming a default way to read, watch and play on the sofa.

name: airpods-wireless-earbuds
description: Cordless earbuds that paired with a phone and lived in a small charging case spread rapidly on streets and trains.

name: samsung-galaxy-fold
description: A phone with a bendable screen that opens into a small tablet finally went on sale after delays and early screen failures.

name: apple-airtag-tracker
description: A coin-sized tag attached to keys or bags could be found on a map by nearby phones.
